# laurent-series-210.txt   (agent W5, notebook Paul/Mathematica/Gaudin/Experiments/Gaudin-Laurent-series.wb, 2026-10-16)
# Exact epsilon-series of the Laurent data of the two-site gl(3) Gaudin chain, Lambda = {2,1,0} on both sites, TWISTED with zeta = eps*phi (zeta = diag twist g = eps*phi), theta = (2/7,-3/5) (theta12 = 31/35) unless stated.
# FORMAT: TAB-separated records, first field = tag, every other field a Wolfram InputForm expression without spaces; lines starting with # are comments. Same conventions as untwisted-exact-*.txt (W4): GT basis, site-2 = highest weight index 1, S2 = e2(zeta) + Sum_s [H_s/(u-th_s) + c2/(u-th_s)^2], S3 = e3(zeta) + Sum_s [b_s/(u-th_s) + a_s/(u-th_s)^2], c2 = lam2(lam1+1).
# BRANCH LABELLING: a branch = (mu, copy): mu = total weight of the HW state in V(x)V (list), copy = 1 (or 2 in multiplicity-2 sectors: the two universal copies of untwisted-exact-*.txt, eigenvectors of A1 = theta12*a_1 on the HW space in Q(Sqrt[D0]); copy 1 = SMALLER a_1 at eps=0 (alpha_1 = tr/2 - f*Sqrt[D0]/2), copy 2 = larger). The branch is the eigenvector of the commuting twisted family tending to that HW vector (G-norm-normalisation irrelevant here).
# Pair notation {p,q} = p + q*Sqrt[D0] (D0 squarefree; D0 = 0 means rational, q = 0). The octet-like sectors with mult 2 have D0 in {105,192} for Lambda=[3,1,0] mu=(5,2,1),(4,3,1) and Lambda=[3,2,0] mu=(5,4,1),(5,3,2).
# E4_SERIES mu copy D0 phi nmax {H1,H2} {a1,a2} {b1,b2} : each of the six lists has nmax+1 pairs {p,q} = coefficients of eps^0..eps^nmax of H_s(eps), a_s(eps), b_s(eps). phi is one of the two numeric twist directions phiA=(1/3,-2/7,5/11), phiB=(-2/5,3/8,7/11). Exact facts verified on every record: H1+H2 = eps*Sum_{i!=j} phi_i mu_j (order 1 only); b1+b2 = eps^2 (phi1 phi2 mu3 + phi1 phi3 mu2 + phi2 phi3 mu1); no-log relations (b_s = a_s(H_s-a_s)/c2 for [2,1,0],[3,1,0], c2 = 3, 4; for [3,2,0] the inhomogeneous quadratic of W3 (Gaudin-L2-chain-320.wb, task B3, with W = phi.mu eps)); scaling in theta: order-n coefficient of H_s,a_s ~ theta12^(n-1), b_s ~ theta12^(n-2).
# E4_SYMBOLIC mu copy D0 name {order0,...,order3} : the same series with symbolic phi = (p1,p2,p3) as InputForm strings (name = H1,H2,a1,a2,b1,b2); Sqrt[D0] appears only for mult-2 copies.
